# Abril Molins Sandner (abruX)

> Esports coordinator and producer based in Ontario, Canada. Coordinates the varsity and academy esports teams at St. Clair College, works on event production and broadcasts (observer, replay operator), and translates games into Spanish and Portuguese. Former professional VALORANT player.
